decision: The action-mode gap is profile-dependent: matched neutral sampled/mean pair survival 16/16 versus 12/16, active 11/16 versus 14/16. Do not deploy sampling as a gate replacement, add shared-fall cost, revive posture shaping or restore an earlier actor. Permit one bounded on-policy training comparison from latest c47edf0b: half Gaussian standard deviation versus unchanged control, all 17 channels active, unchanged physics/rewards/motor/opponent. Preserve all actor/critic/Adam/normalizer/RNG/sampler leaves at the explicit sampling-profile transition; use the same shifted distribution for collection, likelihood ratios and entropy. Maximum 16384 credits per arm/32768 total, source and final untouched 24M full sets, original full screens at 8192/16384, maximum 84000 evaluation controls. Stop severe physical regression or invalid provenance/physics. Evaluate deterministic mean with the original independent gates; no automatic promotion, adoption or further allocation.
